cohort: The study included 217 women who conceived via in vitro fertilization (IVF) and delivered at a tertiary care university hospital.
finding: Among IVF pregnancies, 23.5% experienced third-stage complications, with postpartum hemorrhage being the most common, and multiple gestations, operative vaginal delivery, and emergency cesarean section identified as significant risk factors for PPH.
mod_finding: Operative vaginal delivery (aOR 57) and emergency cesarean section (aOR 14.8) were significant risk factors for postpartum hemorrhage in IVF pregnancies.
